name: Tencent TokenHub Token Plan
notes: Tencent Cloud TokenHub's Token Plan, International (Global) region: a monthly subscription that bills Credits (Standard $17 for 2,600 Credits, Pro $51 for 7,900, Max $103 for 15,900). A Lite tier appears only in a promo banner, with no price or Credits, so it is not shipped. Each model carries the TokenHub pay-as-you-go list prices of the same model (the tencent-tokenhub-intl Provider), so Cost is what a request would cost there; the plan's own Credit rates, such as the November Hy4 credit discount, are not modelled. The plan endpoints are undocumented for the Global region: /plan/v3 (chat completions) and /plan/anthropic (Anthropic Messages) are the Mainland docs' paths (1823/130060), and on the Global host /plan/v3/models answered 401 and /plan/anthropic/v1/messages 405 while an unknown path answered 404. The plan has no Responses endpoint. Bearer auth, as on pay-as-you-go. Which models the plan serves is not published per tier; the shipped list is the pay-as-you-go list, and models.dev lists a smaller set for the plan (also glm-5.4 and mimo-v2.6-flash). Plan Coverage is unknown, so every Provider Account serves every model. No Quota Meters and no plan reader: TokenHub has no usage API for the plan. The plan endpoint needs a plan, so there is no None Plan Choice. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash carries the pay-as-you-go weekday peak rates in the TokenHub Token Plan DeepSeek Peak window (a copy of the pay-as-you-go Provider's window, since a window name is unique across the Catalog). Hy4 and Hy4 Flash carry list prices; their limited-time pay-as-you-go sale is not shipped (ADR 0040). Not flagged for Terms Risk: TokenHub publishes the plan's inference URLs; the promo page's limit to AI tools and not API calls is a use restriction, which the Terms Risk definition ignores. Using the plan through the gateway may still breach it. Release dates are the day each model was first released by any Provider, copied from the original Provider's Catalog file or from models.dev. Not shipped: hy4-preview (retires 2026-12-07), glm-5v-turbo, minimax-m2.7 (retired), the hy-mt translation models, the hunyuan-role and hy-role models, Kimi K2.7 and K2.8, dated snapshots and aliases such as deepseek-v4-pro-202606, deepseek-v4-pro-0813, deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek/deepseek-flash, and embedding, image, video and speech models, which have no Protocol here. Unverified until a live check: the exact model IDs GET /plan/v3/models returns, which model and Protocol combinations TokenHub refuses, whether streams report usage, and which usage field carries cached tokens (prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens on chat completions and cache_read_input_tokens on Anthropic Messages are assumed), the error for exhausted Credits, and the error for a model outside the plan.

pricingWindows.name: TokenHub Token Plan DeepSeek Peak
pricingWindows.notes: TokenHub's DeepSeek peak hours, 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time on weekdays, as the TokenHub price page (1300/78937) and the Token Plan promo page states them; every other hour, weekends included, is off-peak, and a request is billed by when TokenHub receives it. The standard prices of the models that attach it are the off-peak rates.

upstreamModels.name: Hy4 Flash
upstreamModels.notes: On the Token Plan it bills Credits; Cost uses the TokenHub pay-as-you-go prices of the same model. Release date, context size, maximum output and capabilities follow models.dev (Tencent TokenHub) where TokenHub's model list (1823/130051) does not settle them. Prices are TokenHub International (Singapore) pay-as-you-go list prices in USD per million tokens; TokenHub publishes no cache write price. Prices are list prices: until 2026-11-30 12:00 Asia/Shanghai TokenHub settles Hy4 Flash at 50% of them, a limited-time sale the Catalog cannot ship (ADR 0040: no Validity Periods in Catalog files), so Cost overstates requests made during the sale.
